title: Otori Emu — The Barbeque Magistrate?!〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Phoenix Wonderland
Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Didn't practice today feel more springy-springy-boing-boing than normal?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: S-Springy-springy...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, I agree. We all seemed to be in better form than usual today.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: How on earth did you know what she meant by that?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. Who knows?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Well, anyway!
We seem more than ready to get back to our regular show schedule starting next week!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup♪ I can't wait♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wait, next week...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: N-Noooo...!!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Wh-What's wrong?!
Why are you shouting all a sudden?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: B-Because...! Next week... I... I...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
C-Calm down...
Is everything gonna be okay...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Next week, I'm going to the Seaside School♪

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wait, that's it...? You had us going for a second there...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe☆ Sorry...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh, Saki mentioned that she'll be going too and how she had to start packing for it.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Are you all set to go?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: No, not yet, but I know what I need to take!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: First, snacks for each night we're there♪ Oh, I need a bag for keeping any pretty shells and rocks I find, and a beach ball that we can play with...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: And goggles and fins for snorkeling... And... And...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
That does sound nice.
I'm sure you'll have a good time.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hold on, Saki didn't mention anything about needing snorkeling gear.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wait, you don't actually need to take them?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
No, I definitely do...!
I'm gonna cannonball into the water and dive really really deep!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Okay...?
So what are you guys actually gonna be doing while you're there?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Well, we're gonna swim in the ocean, make curry, and put on a show for everyone!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
A show?
I wasn't expecting that...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I see. You have quite an interesting trip ahead of you...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: You could even make a little game out of who gets what ingredients when making curry, no?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah, you're right!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Knowing you, Rui, you'd find a way to make it so no vegetables go into your group's curry.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ah, you might be right there...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: You're making me sound like some sort of evildoer! I was simply suggesting a way to make cooking fun.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Look straight into my eyes and tell me if you can sense anything other than the truth.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I don't have to. I know you're bluffing.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Anyway, Emu, we hope you have a good time!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I will!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, but...
I really wish you guys could come too.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: It's like I'm the only one that's gonna get to have any fun...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: What do you mean? It's a school function, right? Just go and have fun.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I know, but...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hmm... I understand how you feel...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Then why don't we try this? Emu, you go and have fun at the Seaside School. In return, you'll bring back some stories for us to hear.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Oh, yeah.
That might work.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You can tell us about everyone in your group, and what you did at the beach and stuff.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I'll make sure to have lots and lots of fun, and bring back tons of fun stories with me!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, also! What kinds of things do you guys like to do when you go to the beach...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I'll do as many as I can!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: When I go to the beach...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, is it true that you can hear the sea when you put a shell over your ear?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah, I wanna try that!
I'll try looking for some good shells!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Ah, if you wish to do that, I recommend looking for a spiral or cone-shaped shell. A large one too since sound doesn't resonate as well with small ones.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Got it! Thanks, Rui!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
What about you, Tsukasa, Nene?
Any suggestions?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hmm... Let's see...
I've always liked smashing watermelons at the beach, but sports and other games are also fun.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You're taking a beach ball with you, yes? Why not play beach volleyball with everyone?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, beach volleyball's a great idea!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: And since you're going to be at the beach, why don't you try looking for something other than shells too?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It might be fun to find some sea creatures, sea glass, and anything else that might've washed ashore.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah! That does sound like fun!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Alright, I'm gonna do everything and bring back some really fun stories!
